name: 53203 · Milwaukee, WI
findings: ZIP 53203 (Milwaukee) has 68 nonprofit organizations. 29 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 53203 (Milwaukee) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 53203 (Milwaukee) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 5.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 22 organizations here; 22% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?
